methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14. Atlassian Statuspage, Sorry App (sorryapp.com), Hund, StatusPal, and Status.io prices were read directly from their official pages. Better Stack uses a per-responder-seat model with status-page add-ons (no standalone flat plan); the per-responder figure is the smallest billable unit. Instatus prices are JS-rendered and not directly readable; the starting price of $20/month (Pro) and $300/month (Business) was confirmed by two independent aggregators (GetApp, SourceForge) plus a Better Stack comparison article — noted in provenance. Freshstatus (by Freshworks) appears to be entirely free-tier only per GetApp, Capterra, and the Freshworks product site; no paid tiers are publicly listed. Quote-only/Enterprise tiers recorded as monthlyUsd: null throughout. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan as this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: Atlassian Statuspage
vendors.provenance: All plan names and USD prices read directly from the official Atlassian Statuspage pricing page on 2026-06-14. Public Pages and Private Pages are sold as separate product tracks; both are listed here. Audience-Specific Pages start at $300/month (custom setup required, recorded as null). No HIPAA statement found on the pricing or FAQ pages checked.

vendors.name: Better Stack
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from the official Better Stack pricing page (betterstack.com/pricing) on 2026-06-14. Better Stack uses a per-responder-seat model: one status page is included; additional pages and features are metered add-ons. The Responder role at $34/month ($29/year) is the smallest billable unit that unlocks status page editing. White-label, SSO, and IP-allowlisting are each $250/page/month. No HIPAA mention found on the uptime or pricing pages.

plans.name: Team Member (Telemetry)
plans.notes: Read-only Telemetry access; cannot manage incidents or edit status pages.

plans.name: Responder
plans.notes: $34/seat/month billed monthly; $29/seat/month billed annually (~15% discount). Includes uptime monitoring, on-call scheduling, and 1 status page. Additional pages: $15/month each ($12/year). Custom CSS/JS: $15/page/month. White-label or SSO: $250/page/month ($208/year).

vendors.name: Instatus
vendors.provenance: Instatus pricing page (instatus.com/pricing) is JS-rendered and returned no dollar figures on direct fetch (re-confirmed 2026-06-14). Pro $20/month and Business $300/month are corroborated by Instatus's own first-party blog (instatus.com/blog/incident-io-pricing), which states 'Pro ($20/month): 50 monitors with 30-second checks, email and SMS alerts, up to 50 team members' and 'Business ($300/month): up to 1,000 monitors, phone alerts, SAML SSO, all status page types, 25,000 subscribers' — feature sets that match these plans exactly — and by the CheckStatus comparison page (checkstatus.io/compare/instatus/), which repeatedly cites the '$20/mo to $300/mo, 15x' jump. CAVEAT: some 2026 aggregators (PulseSignal, TrustRadius) list Pro $15/month and Business $225/month instead, possibly reflecting an annual-equivalent or a revised tier; PulseSignal's page now returns 'no pricing plans extracted'. The first-party figures ($20/$300) are retained as they are directly attested by Instatus and match the listed features; the discrepancy is flagged here and in plan notes. The official pricing page is kept as the primary source URL for structure; corroboration links point to the first-party blog.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free plan. Includes public status page, 15 monitors, 2-minute checks, email alerts, 5 team members, 200 subscribers. No custom domain.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Pro $20/month (50 monitors, 30-second checks, email and SMS alerts, 50 team members, 5,000 subscribers, custom domain; 25% off annually). Figure attested by Instatus's own blog (instatus.com/blog/incident-io-pricing) and the CheckStatus comparison; not directly readable from the JS-rendered pricing page. Note: some 2026 aggregators list $15/month instead — possible annual-equivalent or revised tier; first-party $20 retained.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Business $300/month (1,000 monitors, 30-second checks, phone/SMS alerts, unlimited team members, 25,000 subscribers, SAML SSO, all status page types, custom domains; 25% off annually). Figure attested by Instatus's own blog (instatus.com/blog/incident-io-pricing) and the CheckStatus comparison's '$20→$300 cliff'. Note: some 2026 aggregators list $225/month instead — possible annual-equivalent or revised tier; first-party $300 retained.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Includes SCIM directory sync, priority support, 99.99% uptime SLA, multiple SSO connections, custom contracts.

vendors.name: Hund
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from the official Hund pricing page (hund.io/pricing) on 2026-06-14. The base plan starts at $29/month and is usage-based above the included quotas (20 components, 250 managed email subscribers). Enterprise and Sovereign Enterprise tiers are quote-only. Starting price of $29/month corroborated by the Slashdot comparison listing. No HIPAA mention found on the Hund website.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Starts at $29/month. Includes unlimited traffic, unlimited users, unlimited issues, 20 components (additional component packs $20-$29/pack of 40), 250 managed email subscribers (overage $0.025-$0.03 each), custom domain with HTTPS, CSS/HTML/JS customization, live event streaming, REST API, RBAC. 30-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Custom SLAs, custom contracts, priority support at scale.

plans.name: Sovereign Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Dedicated account management, isolated high-availability infrastructure, custom data residency.

vendors.name: Sorry™
vendors.provenance: Price of $99/month read directly from the official Sorry App pricing page (sorryapp.com/pricing) on 2026-06-14. The product offers a single self-serve tier; add-ons (extra team members at $5/month each) and a quote-only Enterprise plan are also listed. Direct fetch of sorry.com returned ECONNREFUSED; sorryapp.com is the correct domain and returned successfully.

plans.name: Status Page
plans.notes: US$99/month. 1,000 subscribers, 5 team members (+$5/member/month), incident metrics, email/Slack/Teams/Google Chat notifications, custom domain, REST API, SAML SSO, RBAC. 7-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.name: Freshstatus
vendors.provenance: Freshstatus (by Freshworks) appears to be entirely free-tier only. No paid plans were found on GetApp (getapp.com/it-management-software/a/freshstatus/pricing/), Capterra, or the Freshworks product pages checked on 2026-06-14. Multiple reviewer aggregators confirm 'free version' with no listed paid tier pricing. The product URL freshstatus.io returns a TLS certificate error; the Freshworks parent domain (freshworks.com/statuspage) returns 404. Included with null plans and explanatory notes.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Completely free status page and incident communication tool by Freshworks. No paid tiers publicly listed as of 2026-06-14. High user ratings for value on GetApp (4.7/5 from 73 reviews) suggest the free plan covers most needs.

vendors.name: StatusPal
vendors.provenance: Plan names and regular monthly USD prices read directly from statuspal.io/pricing on 2026-06-14. The page shows first-year promotional prices (30-50% off) alongside regular prices; the regular (recurring) prices are used here: $46 Hobby, $99 Startup, $299 Business. The promotional first-year rates ($32, $59, $149) are noted in plan notes. SourceForge lists a starting price of $26/month which may reflect a legacy rate; the official page is used as authoritative. Enterprise is quote-only.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: $99/month regular price. First year billed at $59/month (40% off). 20 team members, 1,000 subscribers, 30 monitored services, 2 languages, public and private pages, 300-day incident retention. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $299/month regular price. First year billed at $149/month (50% off). 50 team members, 4,000 subscribers, 100 monitored services, 3 languages, public and private pages, SSO, unlimited incident retention. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Custom team members, subscribers, and monitored services. 30% off first year also available on Enterprise.

vendors.name: Status.io
vendors.provenance: Plan names and USD prices read directly from status.io/pricing on 2026-06-14. The page shows a 5% annual discount; effective annual monthly rates calculated from that. Enterprise starts at $999/month (listed price, not quote-only). No HIPAA or BAA mention found on the security page; GDPR and SOC 2 compliance confirmed.
